Council Agenda Background
PRESENTER: 
Michael
Wells, City Secretary
DATE: 01/ 22/ 19
Council
Mission
Area: 
Encourage citizen involvement. 
ITEM: 
Consider a resolution ordering the General Election of the City of Bedford, Texas to be held on
Saturday, May 4, 2019 for the purpose of electing Place 3 and Place 5 to the Bedford City Council. 
City Attorney Review: 
Yes
SUMMARY: 
This item is to formally order the General Election for Place 3 and Place 5 on the City Council to be
held on Saturday, May 4, 2019. The filing period for this election started on Wednesday, January 16
and runs through Friday, February 15. 
Early voting
begins
on Monday, April
22 and runs through
Tuesday, April 30. The main early voting location in Bedford will be the Public Library; however, 
residents can vote at any Tarrant County early voting location. Voting on Election Day will only be
held at the Pat May Center at 1849B Central Drive. 
BACKGROUND: 
This resolution
is to order the General
Election
to be held
on May 4, 2019 to elect two City Council
members, Place 3 and Place 5, to be filled for three years or until their successors are duly elected
and qualified. Pursuant to Section 3. 005(c) of the Texas Election Code, a city must order its election
no later than the 78th day before Election Day, which this year falls on Friday, February 15, 2019. 
Early voting
begins
on Monday, April 22 and runs through
Tuesday, April
30. The main early voting
location in Bedford will be the Public Library; however, residents can vote at an Tarrant County early
voting location. The early voting schedule
is below: 
April
22 - 26
Monday - Friday
8: 00 a. m. - 5: 00 p.m.

27

7: 00 a. m. - 7: 00 p.m.

7: 00 a. m. - 7: 00 p.m. 
Election
Day is 7: 00 a. m. to 7: 00 p. m., Saturday, May 4, 2019 and voting
will only be held at the Pat
May Center at 1849B Central
Drive. 
A runoff
election, 
if
necessary, 
ensuing
from
the
May
4, 2019
General
Election, 
is
tentatively
scheduled for June 8, 2019. 
As in the past and per state law, staff recommends
that this election
be held jointly and administered
by the Tarrant County Election' s Administration. This has proven to be the most cost effective and
efficient way to hold elections. The exact cost of the election is not known at this time and will depend
on how many entities end up contracting
with the County. Generally, the County will send a cost
estimate
in April with a finalized
total being sent in August. 
RECOMMENDATION: 
Staff recommends the following motion: 
Approval of a resolution ordering the General Election of the City of Bedford, Texas to be held on
Saturday, May 4, 2019 for the purpose
of electing
Place
3 and Place
5 to the Bedford
City Council.
